C0564.title: Exploiting '7-Day No-Reason Return' Policy: Swapping Phones with Dummy Units Leads to Detention
C0564.summary: Between September and October 2025, suspect Tao repeatedly purchased mobile phones on e-commerce platforms, replaced the genuine devices with dummy models after unboxing, resealed the packaging, and requested 7-day no-reason returns on the grounds that the packaging was intact.
